data.long_meaning: The name Lalchand is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Lal’ meaning 'God' and ‘Chand’ meaning 'Grace'. This name represents the divine grace bestowed by God upon an individual. In Hindu mythology, Lalchand is a popular name for deities and spiritual beings, symbolizing the blessings and protection of the divine. The name Lalchand carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lalchand usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
